question: To what kind of person, tested over a fixed period, is this teaching required to be given rather than withheld?
premises: The teaching is not to be given indiscriminately to all recipients.
Only one who has prior accomplishment qualifies as a recipient.
Qualification requires testing for the duration of one year.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: Criteria for prior accomplishment remain unspecified
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
